pages.title: Discover Sustainable Adventure: Omega Eco Jungle Lodge & Tours
pages.description: Embark on a journey of eco-conscious exploration with Omega Eco Jungle Lodge & Tours. Nestled in the heart of Pico Bonito National Park in La Ceiba, Honduras, our sustainable lodge offers unforgettable experiences an activities amidst lush jungles. Explore diverse ecosystems, encounter exotic wildlife, and immerse yourself in eco-friendly lodge. Start your adventure today!
pages.text:
Discover Sustainable Adventure: Omega Eco Jungle Lodge & Tours
Join Us In Nature
Welcome to Omega Jungle Lodge & Adventure Company
Omega Jungle Lodge is an absolute tropical paradise in the Cangrejal River Valley. This pristine landscape is surrounded by lush vegetation and dense rainforests, making it one of the most beautiful destinations perfect for relaxation and for those who love adventure.
Read More
White water & other adventures in the jungle
Omega Lodge is known for extraordinary white water rafting and a great variety of amazing nature and adventure tours. As well as unique accommodations, friendly service and last but not least, delicious meals.
Omega Lodge is a sustainably grown business that started as a white water rafting and kayaking company with an adventurous spirit, pioneering the Cangrejal River Valley and other wilderness areas all over the country. It is still operated by its German owner, a former member of the German National Kayaking and Rafting Team who started Omega Tours back in 1992 being the first business of its kind in Honduras. The Lodge is situated where the white water adventures and the other tours start.
In its surroundings, you can observe the jungle´s beauty in its natural environment. It also feature a botanical wonderland with a wild collection of fruit, ornamental and medicinal plants.
Wildlife in the Cangrejal Valley
Nestled between Pico Bonito and Nombre de Dios National Parks, we are home to some unique fauna, flora and wildlife. Explore our magnificent piece of earth and observe what the jungle has to offer.

pages.title: Experience Nature's Embrace at Omega Eco Jungle Lodge | La Ceiba, Honduras
pages.text:
Experience Nature's Embrace at Omega Eco Jungle Lodge | La Ceiba, Honduras
What we offer
Omega Jungle Lodge
We are the perfect choice if you are looking for an unforgetabble stay in our hideaway lodge.
View D etails
Omega Jungle Lodge is the first one of its kind in Honduras and still outstanding for its beauty, natural ambience, sustainability and eco friendliness.
We house some of the most stunning accommodations found in Honduras with beautiful views, tasteful artistic details, great bathrooms and private porches with hammocks. Our lodge is designed to let the natural airflow breeze through the rooms. Everything is original and tastefully designed for you to indulge in nature.
All construction and furniture are designed and crafted using recycled materials and are built on site with the help of local workers. We use lots of natural materials from around and developed our own solar hot water system. Our used water gets recycled and fresh water is treated with one of the most effective systems found in Honduras.
In addition to the great variety of rooms there is outstanding surroundings in which our guests spend a lot of their time; in our cool freshwater pool, relaxing in hammocks or being active on the lodge hiking trails, the yoga platform or exploring the creeks and the river.
It is a pure natural and truly inspiring environment with lots of birds and tropical plants: fruits, flowers, medicinal, ornamental, orchids.
Everything is secluded in the jungle, away from road and neighbours.
We also provide: free purified water, WiFi, laundry service, Honduras information, shuttle services, book exchange and table games.
All our room include a great breakfast a la carte!
